text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning. In an empty pool, 
Casino Drive was engaged in "special 
training."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: *Gurgle gurgle*... Pwaha!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... It takes everything just to float. 
Why am I so completely incapable of 
swimming...?)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(The pool inspection with the project 
stakeholders... It's still a while away, 
but there's bound to be a moment where I 
must swim...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, as an advisor to the academy, I 
cannot show such an embarrassing state to 
anyone...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: I must prepare countermeasures thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way to training, I 
happened to spot Casino Drive, but...
choice_data_list: Casino, what in the world is that...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san? Ah... um, well, this is—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
These are... parts for an underwater 
camera. I negotiated with a swim coach I 
know and borrowed their latest model.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Well, that is... I thought it would be 
useful for training... for everyone's 
training!
choice_data_list:
You went through all that trouble for 
that?! Incredible!

You went through all that trouble for 
that?! Incredible!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Indeed! With this, efficient form 
analysis becomes possible.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
There will inevitably be those who 
struggle with swimming. To make their 
training more effective—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
We must implement thorough countermeasures 
to overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fear of water, difficulty maintaining 
balance. Discomfort with swimming is not 
easily erased, but—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Any obstacle can be overcome with effort! 
I shall face it with everything I have and 
solve it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think she cares this much about all the 
students! I want to support that 
passionate dedication.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I will be setting up the camera now... No 
assistance is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You have a role that only you can fulfill. 
Guide your horse girl toward the future 
with your own hands!
choice_data_list: Oh...! Understood, I'll give it my all!
Wow...! Understood, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That evening. Hair still damp, I spotted 
her utterly exhausted in front of a 
vending machine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have been meticulously checking 
the camera operations. I felt inspired to 
learn from her hardworking spirit!
